name: **[Storra (Cloud Storage Platform)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Personal-Google-Drive)** | Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, AWS S3, AWS EC2
summary: A secure cloud storage platform with role-based access control, file sharing, and robust authentication integration.
highlights: Architected a secure cloud storage API supporting file uploads, downloads, streaming previews, and metadata management.
Engineered a robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system with granular global and user-specific file sharing permissions with 3 roles Owner, Admin and User.
Implemented inclusive authentication flows combining OTP verification with external OAuth integrations (Google, GitHub).
Reduced potential security vulnerabilities by implementing robust defenses against SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, and DoS attacks.

name: **[ShipIt (Self-Hosted CI/CD Server)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Storra)** | Node.js, PM2, Telegram API, Octokit, AWS S3 + CloudFront
summary: A lightweight, self-hosted CI/CD server that deploys on GitHub push events via webhooks and SSH, featuring smart dependency detection, automatic rollback on unhealthy releases, Telegram notifications, and frontend delivery to S3 + CloudFront.
highlights: Built a webhook-triggered deployment system that SSHs into remote servers, pulls latest code, and skipping `dependency installation` when no dependencies changed.
Engineered a symlink-based release system with automatic rollback on health-check failure, maintaining last working code in versioned release directories.
Integrated Telegram Bot API to send structured deployment summaries with log tails on success/failure, and set GitHub commit statuses using Octokit for pending/success/failure states.
Implemented branch-based deployments, S3 + CloudFront frontend hosting with AWS CLI, and Redis-stored deployment logs with 7-day TTL for step-by-step inspection.

name: **[Banaras Mart (Ecommerce App)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Banaras-Mart)** | Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Razorpay
summary: A role-based multi-vendor e-commerce platform with secure JWT authentication, product management, and Razorpay payment integration.
highlights: Developed a comprehensive e-commerce backend supporting product management, cart states, and user wishlists.
Engineered efficient product discovery APIs featuring advanced database filtering and dynamic pagination.
Integrated the Razorpay API to securely process transactions and orchestrate seamless checkout workflows.
Implemented a secure user management system handling registration, authentication, and password recovery.
